purpose: Teach: たどり着い/サス/塀/乗用車/新生/捕らえ/クライマックス/盛りだくさん

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ようやく、お祖父ちゃんち、たどり着いたね、長かったね、ぼく、疲れちゃったよ、本当に。
lines.en: Mom, we finally made it to Grandpa's. That took forever. I'm really tired.
lines.style: Breathless arrival, words tumbling out with relief and fatigue. Small boy exhausted from travel. Slight whine on the final phrase—seeking sympathy without quite asking for it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。サスペンス小説、お父さん、最近、よく、読んでるわよね、翔くん、知ってた、ママに、教えてくれたわよ。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. Your grandfather's been reading a lot of mystery novels lately, hasn't he? You told me about that.
lines.style: Gentle, almost thinking aloud. Warm acknowledgment of her son's attention to detail. A mother recognizing and reflecting back what he's observed. Soft, encouraging tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お庭の塀、お父さんと、ぼく、ペンキ、塗ったよ、ママ、見て、お洒落になったよ、本当に!
lines.en: Dad and I painted the garden fence, Mom. Look—it looks so nice now. Really nice!
lines.style: Bright pride spilling out. Quick cadence, eager to show off the small accomplishment. Voice lifts on 'really nice'—seeking her approval and sharing in the work with his father.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、新しい乗用車、検討してるって、お祖父ちゃんに、相談してたわよ、翔くん、知ってた?
lines.en: Your father's been talking to Grandpa about getting a new car, you know. Did you know that?
lines.style: Conversational curiosity, testing whether her son has picked up on this detail too. Light, interested tone—not probing, just gently curious. A mother noticing her child notices things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: いとこ、赤ちゃん、新生児って、いうんだよね、ママ、抱っこ、させてもらえるかな、楽しみだよ、ぼく。
lines.en: A newborn—that's what you call a cousin baby, right? Do you think they'll let me hold her? I'm so excited.
lines.style: Quiet anticipation underneath childlike eagerness. Gentle wondering rather than demanding. The 'ぼく' comes through as vulnerable hope—will he be allowed, trusted with something so small?

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 写真、ぱっと、その瞬間を、捕らえるの、ママ、上手なのよ、お父さんに、よく、言われるわよ、嬉しい。
lines.en: Your mother's really good at capturing the moment in photographs—your father tells me that all the time. It makes me happy.
lines.style: Warm pride in her own skill, delivered almost like she's sharing a small secret with her son. Slight smile in the voice. Genuine pleasure, not boasting—the kind of quiet satisfaction of being seen and appreciated.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 昨日見た映画、クライマックス、ぼく、本当に、ドキドキしたよ、ママ、覚えてる、家族で、見たやつ?
lines.en: That movie we watched yesterday—the climax really got my heart racing. Do you remember? When we all watched it together as a family?
lines.style: Animated recollection, genuine excitement bleeding through. She's testing whether he remembers too, sharing the thrill. Faster pace on 'climax,' then a slight slowdown as she looks back fondly on the shared moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの家、お料理、いつも、盛りだくさんね、翔くん、お腹いっぱい、なっちゃうわよね、いつも。
lines.en: Grandma's cooking is always so abundant, isn't it? You always end up so full.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate observation. Steady, knowing tone—a mother watching her son's happiness with food and family. Slight chuckle underneath. Contentment wrapped in gentle humor.
